Return Policy

Parts returned for exchange or refund must be in new resalable condition. You must have a copy of your reciept. 

No returns for refund after 15 days (after product is received). 

Returned items must be unused and unchanged from their original new condition. Must also be in original packaging. No return or exchange on any part installed or used.

All refunds are subject to a MINIMUM 15% restocking fee and returned freight unless the reason for the refund or return is our fault.  

Any part that is damaged or defecting in shipping will be evaluated before replacing. Any product that is deemed as our fault in shipping will be taking care of at no charge.

Call for a return authorization number before shipping anything back! 

Some parts may have warranties by the manufacturer and have to be shipped directly to them.

Pancho’s Racing Products Inc. makes no warranties, guarantees, or liability, either express or implied, written or oral. Pancho’s Racing Products Inc will NOT be liable for any loss, damage, or injury arising from the use of these products. Parts and labor are sold on a development basis.
